quality_system.description: Case library integrity system. Three-layer defence against data corruption and clinician dishonesty.

layers.name: Structured data input
layers.principle: No free-text dominance. Forces structured entry.
layers.rationale: Reduces bias and fabrication by limiting interpretive freedom at entry

layers.name: AI plausibility scoring (coherence index)
layers.principle: Not censorship — confidence/coherence index. Flags, does not delete.
checks: Does the pattern fit others in the library?
layers.action_if_low_score: Flagged for human review. Not auto-deleted. Escalated to admin/board.

layers.name: Peer review layer
layers.principle: Founding clinicians can comment anonymously. Precedent-law logic.
features: would you treat similarly? — binary vote

quality_system.case_library_concept: Clinical precedent engine. Cases function as legal precedents — indirect evidence from prior similar cases with documented outcomes.
